tools.name: finalize_asset
tools.description: Finalize an authored collection through every step, exporting one animation FBX per rig clip and importing the clips as AnimSequences, then import it into Unreal. Returns {job_id, status} at once; includes the result when the job finishes within wait_seconds (0-150). compatible_with lists <Category>/<Name> characters whose skeleton the clips may also play on.

tools.name: run_finalize_step
tools.description: Run one finalize step (validate, bake, variants, export, export_anims, reimport, import_ue, or import_anims) through the same implementation finalize_asset uses. Returns {job_id, status} at once, or the finished result within wait_seconds (0-150).

tools.name: import_audio
tools.description: Import a saved ElevenLabs sound effect or music file into Unreal as a SoundWave. Stores a 16-bit WAV under SourceArt/Audio/<SFX|Music>/ and imports /Game/Audio/<SFX|Music>/SW_<name>. Returns the result, or an error object.

tools.name: get_finalize_job
tools.description: Return a finalize job's state, step, progress, message, and result or error. An unknown id returns finalize.job_not_found.
